Have Got to and Going to Have to for What Is Necessary
When you want to express that something is important or necessary to do, you can use have got and going to have to.
We've got to take into account that this framework is going to broaden the focus of the internet and allow us to keep an appropriate control of the information.
One of the things that you are going to have to acquire is an advanced knowledge of software languages through this framework.

For both cases, it is necessary to consider the correct syntax and the appropriate subject-verb agreement.

Example:

Nate has got to try different programming languages.

I have got to update this application.

Now, have a look at the examples with going to have to:

Sarah is going to have to program using .Net framework.

Nick and Brenda are going to have to take a training course on C++.
How to Paraphrase Information in a Text
When you paraphrase, you are writing the same information using your own words.

It is important to learn to paraphrase in order to focus concisely on a single main idea and to take information from another person in a legitimate way.

There are 5 steps for effective paraphrasing:

  1. Read several times, if necessary, the original article or text until you have a complete understanding of the topic.
  2. Start to write down ideas in your own words keeping the original text aside.
  3. Make a comparison between your text and the original. See if your version accurately expresses all the essential information.
  4. Use quotation marks for expressions or ideas you take directly from the original text. Identify key words and try to look for synonyms to convey the same meaning.
  5. Use a note card to write your paraphrased text and record the source including the page.

images.text: Hello, everyone. Today, we'll discuss the importance of .Net programming in our software development company. .Net has established a new way software is developed nowadays. It is now clear that the .Net framework is going to help the platforms we already use for software development. We've got to take into account that this framework is going to broaden the focus of the internet and allow us to keep an appropriate control of the information. When program designers work on the creation of software, they trust in this framework due to its effectiveness to undertake various tasks. We, as an innovative software development company, are going to have to implement advantageous techniques in order to be successful in the field of software design.

.Net framework is going to become an excellent tool for us when creating applications since it will enable you all to develop, manufacture, and implement them in any Windows-based system. One of the things that you are going to have to acquire is an advanced knowledge of software languages through this framework. It is very important to know the language you are using so that you can take advantage of the framework. You have got to understand that many programs are based on this framework so that they can run correctly on each computer. If you are designing or installing an application or program, you will notice that it won't generate any error, and it'll run and update faster.

Therefore, we are going to make use of the .Net framework in every as possible so that we can meet the expectations of our customers regarding security, stability, manageability, and the correct functioning of the products we deliver.
